import workcell
tare = 122.65
LO, HI = 249.80, 250.20

def net_now():
    s = workcell.call("scale", "read")
    g = s.data["gross_g"]
    net = round(g - tare, 2)
    print(f"gross {g:.2f} net {net:.2f} need {round(250-net,2):.2f}", flush=True)
    return net

net = 247.65  # last reading; re-read to be sure? costs 4s. trust it and dose.
# fines until need <= 1.05 or in range
for i in range(6):
    need = round(250.00 - net, 2)
    if LO <= net <= HI:
        print("IN RANGE", net)
        break
    if net > HI:
        print("OVER", net)
        break
    if need <= 1.05:
        print("to micro", net)
        break
    r = workcell.robot("dose", "fine")
    print("FINE", r.text, flush=True)
    net = net_now()

if net > HI:
    print("removing overshoot")
    r = workcell.robot("remove")
    print(r.text)
    net = net_now()

# micros: batch based on conservative 0.14 g each, leave 0.15 g margin
while net < LO:
    need = round(250.00 - net, 2)
    # how many micros can we safely add?
    # assume 0.08-0.17 g
    room = round(250.15 - net, 2)  # don't exceed 250.15
    if room <= 0:

    n = max(1, int(room / 0.16))  # conservative count
    # but also don't add way more than needed
    n_need = max(1, int(need / 0.12))
    n = min(n, n_need, 4)
    print(f"batch {n} micros, need {need}", flush=True)
    for i in range(n):
        r = workcell.robot("dose", "micro")
        print("MICRO", r.text, flush=True)
    net = net_now()
    if net > HI:
        print("OVER after micro")
        break

print("FINAL", net)

python3 << 'PY'
import workcell
tare = 122.65
LO, HI = 249.80, 250.20

def net_now():
    s = workcell.call("scale", "read")
    g = s.data["gross_g"]
    net = round(g - tare, 2)
    print(f"gross {g:.2f} net {net:.2f} need {round(250-net,2):.2f}", flush=True)
    return net

net = 247.65  # last reading; re-read to be sure? costs 4s. trust it and dose.
# fines until need <= 1.05 or in range
for i in range(6):
    need = round(250.00 - net, 2)
    if LO <= net <= HI:
        print("IN RANGE", net)
        break
    if net > HI:
        print("OVER", net)
        break
    if need <= 1.05:
        print("to micro", net)
        break
    r = workcell.robot("dose", "fine")
    print("FINE", r.text, flush=True)
    net = net_now()

if net > HI:
    print("removing overshoot")
    r = workcell.robot("remove")
    print(r.text)
    net = net_now()

# micros: batch based on conservative 0.14 g each, leave 0.15 g margin
while net < LO:
    need = round(250.00 - net, 2)
    # how many micros can we safely add?
    # assume 0.08-0.17 g
    room = round(250.15 - net, 2)  # don't exceed 250.15
    if room <= 0:
        break
    n = max(1, int(room / 0.16))  # conservative count
    # but also don't add way more than needed
    n_need = max(1, int(need / 0.12))
    n = min(n, n_need, 4)
    print(f"batch {n} micros, need {need}", flush=True)
    for i in range(n):
        r = workcell.robot("dose", "micro")
        print("MICRO", r.text, flush=True)
    net = net_now()
    if net > HI:
        print("OVER after micro")
        break

print("FINAL", net)
PY
